OWNER DECISIONS 2026-10-01 (in chat) on the v0b gate (34d575d4: literal type-B 1e-6 noise-free parity FAIL, max 6.1e-5 relative; everything else passes):
(1) Amend the protocol so the type-B parity tolerance is derived in advance from float32 precision. Compare GLMsingle against a float64 fit of the same model, with the bound set by single-precision error and design conditioning. The bound is fixed before the rerun, is not a raised threshold, and is reviewed as an amendment.
(2) The T-G cells use TR-aligned onsets, so GLMsingle sees the true design; sub-TR onsets stay in the other families.
